# runr_runtime_patches (Data Source)

A project's runtime patch state ([runtime patches](https://runr.sh/docs/runtimes/#runtime-patches)): the patch its deployment runs, the newest one, the pin and the newest patches of its runtime version. A report to read, e.g. for checks or outputs.

Applying, pinning and unpinning a patch stay actions (`runr projects patch apply|pin|unpin`): a pin names one of the five newest patches of a feed that keeps moving, and RunR itself lifts or sets pins when a critical or zero-day deadline passes, so a pin declared in Terraform would fight RunR.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runr_runtime_patches" "api" {
  project_id = runr_project.api.id
}

# Fail the plan while the project runs behind a critical patch past its deadline.
check "runtime_patch" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.runr_runtime_patches.api.state != "overdue"
    error_message = "orders-api runs behind ${data.runr_runtime_patches.api.latest.tag}: run `runr projects patch apply orders-api`."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project id.

### Read-Only

- `auto_migrate` (Boolean) RunR moves projects onto critical / zero-day patches at their deadline.
- `current` (Attributes) The patch the live deployment runs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current))
- `deadline_at` (String) Earliest critical / zero-day deadline of those patches.
- `deployed` (Boolean) The project has a live deployment.
- `keep` (Number) How many of the newest patches a project can be pinned to.
- `latest` (Attributes) The newest patch of the project's runtime version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--latest))
- `level` (String) Most urgent level of the patches the project runs behind.
- `patches` (Attributes List) The newest patches of the project's runtime version, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--patches))
- `pending` (List of String) Ids of the newer patches the project does not run yet.
- `pin` (Attributes) The patch the project is pinned to; null without a pin. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pin))
- `state` (String) `up_to_date`, `patch_available`, `pinned` or `overdue` (a critical / zero-day deadline passed); null when no patch concerns the project (a container project, a runtime version without patches).

<a id="nestedatt--current"></a>
### Nested Schema for `current`

Read-Only:

- `digest` (String) Image digest.
- `id` (String) Patch id (null for a digest deployed before patches were known).
- `level` (String) `routine`, `security`, `critical` or `zero-day`.
- `published_at` (String) When the patch was published.
- `tag` (String) Patch tag, e.g. `exec-php:8.3.36-r1`.


<a id="nestedatt--latest"></a>
### Nested Schema for `latest`

Read-Only:

- `digest` (String) Image digest.
- `id` (String) Patch id (null for a digest deployed before patches were known).
- `level` (String) `routine`, `security`, `critical` or `zero-day`.
- `published_at` (String) When the patch was published.
- `tag` (String) Patch tag, e.g. `exec-php:8.3.36-r1`.


<a id="nestedatt--patches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patches`

Read-Only:

- `cves` (List of String) CVEs it fixes.
- `deadline_at` (String) Deadline of a critical / zero-day patch.
- `digest` (String) Image digest.
- `id` (String) Patch id.
- `image` (String) Image.
- `level` (String) `routine`, `security`, `critical` or `zero-day`.
- `published_at` (String) When it was published.
- `reason` (String) Why it came.
- `tag` (String) Patch tag.
- `url` (String) Release notes.


<a id="nestedatt--pin"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pin`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Still one of the newest patches (else the next deploy uses the newest).
- `by` (String) Who pinned it (`runr` for the pin of a rolled-back automatic migration).
- `digest` (String) Image digest.
- `id` (String) Patch id.
- `tag` (String) Patch tag.
